identityNote: A/B and generation references are report aliases only; all actual logical/task/generation IDs are preserved above. Task IDs are opaque observations, not permanent document identities.
snapshotNote: Each window contains its last retained geometry, not a simultaneous fresh measurement. Closed A geometry and its last windowFocus value are historical, not live focus. Caption rectangles are relative to the inset frame. Geometry references deduplicate equal retained values across checkpoints; they are report aliases, not extra measurements.

selectedLifecycleEvents.detail: Inspect the new task/window; return is not qualification.
Device metadata is shared by the process.
Inspect section errors; completion is not qualification.

eventSelectionNote: Selected exact events from consistent overlapping report exports. All 139 sequence values were available across exports; the final report retains 128 and records 11 dropped events. This public record intentionally includes only milestone events.

saveFault.harnessDeviation: Host assertion expected the word failed; actual correct UI said could not be saved. The assertion mismatch interrupted the harness, not the app. Cleanup restored mode 771 from 551; the operator verified restoration and explicitly retried Refresh.
saveFault.durabilityBoundary: This was a private-directory write-permission fault, not power loss, out-of-space or an injected AtomicFile rename failure.

quietSampling.interpretation: First read preceded the marker save (111→112); later settled samples all remained at revision 128. No continuing revision churn observed over the short settled span; not a soak test.

harnessNotes: s2-a-marker.json was a pre-save export still at revision 9; later revisions 21/23 establish the marker action.

The UI helper adapted flat/nested layout shapes and reacquired visible control bounds; a preliminary helper failure is not an app recreation failure. Successful recreation is established by events 30–40.

capabilityDecision.reason: This increment covers plain probe windows only; P0-S2 operation lifetimes, system process-death, engagement and final platform decision remain incomplete. All product capability gates remain pending.
